verdict.rationale: Smooth is a cloud browser-automation service with an SDK and CLI, so a telemetry opt-out is a fair question for it. The evidence pack documents no setting, environment variable or flag to disable telemetry or usage tracking. Zero Data Retention is an adjacent enterprise feature that deletes completed-task data; it is not an opt-out of telemetry, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
